findings.finding: The repair spans multiple sub-steps consumed via an agent-readable status surface (git checkout restore of class 1, quarantine move of class 2, then reconverge), but the plan specifies no fallback / repair_status when a sub-step fails partway — e.g. a checkout that fails on one class-1 path, a quarantine move that fails for some-but-not-all class-2 paths (the existing _quarantine_untracked returns False on any failure), and whether the post-repair reconverge still runs after a partial repair failure.
